steps.name: come back to the open list

unrecorded.first_answer_seen: when a page first showed GitHub's answer: a page reports a wait only once it is late, so the time to a first answer is not in the log
unrecorded.local_cache_hits: reads the server answered from its own store: those make no gh call, so cache_hits counts only the 304s GitHub answered
unrecorded.store_turn_waits: time a job waited for its turn at the store: queued counts only the waits for a network slot
